1473614221ae5228.coaching_text: Today, the river of your attention flowed for 350 minutes, a gentle ripple beyond the 300-minute shore you had set. Within this current, Entertainment (151 minutes) and Social Media (113 minutes) carried a significant portion, amounting to 264 minutes of unstructured time. Consider, beloved one, that this precious time, like water seeking new channels, could have nurtured 0.82 books read, carried you on a journey of 22.0 kilometers, or even gifted you 224 minutes of restorative sleep. As the day closes, we might gently inquire: where does your inner compass truly wish to guide your journey tomorrow?
